note: Limits are conservative defaults from the design-for-printing guide in text-to-cad (Hubs and Formlabs guides, ISO/ASTM 52910). The 256 mm plate is an assumption; check your printer.
buildPlateNote: A common 256 mm build plate (Bambu Lab A1 / P1 / X1 class). An assumption, shown on screen.
scaleSuggestion: The biggest model that prints: walls hold and it fits the plate. Walk scales from the largest model and take the first that passes. A bridge warning does not reject a scale.

wall.meaning: A freestanding model wall is an unsupported wall.
wall.belowMinimum: Below the minimum, they may break or not print. Thickening them so they print means the model is not true to scale in wall thickness.

bridge.meaning: The beam over a door or window prints as a bridge.
bridge.overLimit: Over the bridge limit, turn on supports in your slicer. Slicers add them.

fit.overPlate: Larger than the plate: choose a smaller scale.
